Wall cling with [Shift]

structure.vampires.vampire_crypt.book.ov:
Enter the Overworld through the black fog.

Slay so many humans that they have no choice but to send out their strongest mages.

Then, slay those mages to obtain Markers towards the Guardians of the world. 

Killing any one of them will give you the means of reviving the Abyssal Lord. In short...

§cPillage. Destroy. §4Feed.
structure.vampires.vampire_crypt.book.gr:
Press [G] to Ground Slam and find food sources. 

Very useful for spotting hidden enemies mid-combat, or protecting yourself from incoming damage.
structure.vampires.vampire_crypt.book.pl:
Place your Chest down and grab your weapons.

You will be given new weapons, armour and spells with each new life.

Hold [Shift] and [Left Click], then drag your mouse across items to quickly grab them.
structure.vampires.vampire_crypt.book.gl:
Press [Spacebar] mid-air to glide.

Sneak with [Shift] mid-air to stop gliding. This is useful for conserving durability.

Dash whilst gliding with [CTRL] for a speed boost!

quest.vampires.bosses_detected.title: Electrocutioner
quest.vampires.bosses_detected.descripti: That mage... I need to end him if I'm to find the locations of the Guardians.
quest.vampires.chest_particles.title: Repeatable Chest
quest.vampires.give_citadel_location.des: The Mantlediver... With this tool, I can drill deep into the Earth to find the location of the Citadel. My final challenge will await me there...

quest.vampires.give_revenant_ashes.descr: Defeat the Ignited Revenant and claim its Burning Ashes.
quest.vampires.h01_hunter_introduction.d:
"This land is falling into darkness... I can feel it. Although the supernatural have been pushed back to the caves, mankind have only taken their place in their monstrosity."

"The Empire's cruelty knows no bounds... And even with it, they fail to see the threat growing beneath their feet."

"A §4§oVampire§r is on the loose. They were supposed to be extinct..."

"I have to stop it, no matter the cost. It matters not if these people would treat §oit§r and §oI§r the same: I WILL save them."

"I can cut off this infection from the source... I must find the §4§oAbyssal Lord§r. I'm certain one of the acclaimed Mages of the Illager Clan would know where to find them."

"I don't want to, but with their vendetta against me... §oIt looks like I'll have to find out the hard way§r."
quest.vampires.marker_electrocutioner_sc: With the Electrocutioner slain, the path to the Acropolis will be clear...
quest.vampires.marker_illusioner_maledic: With the Illusioner slain, the path to the Frosted Prison will be clear...
With the Pyreillager slain, the path to the Dragon Tower will be clear...
You awaken in a coffin, buried in a crypt deep underground. 

Time has taken its toll; You have no memory of how you got here or who you even are... 
Only that you are a foul distortion of nature - A §o§l§4Vampire§r. 

Though there is nothing to immediately indicate it, you can tell that you're alone... 

Not in this crypt, but in the §oworld§r: Perhaps the last sapient Vampire alive.

You had... A §o§lMaster§r, didn't you?

Where is your Master?
How could they allow this to happen...? 

You have no idea how long you've been asleep, but you §odo§r know what must come next... 

Seek audience with the §4§o§lAbyssal Lord§r, and earn their favour to reclaim the Overworld.

The humans will pay for their insolence...
It's time for them to wake up and smell the ashes.
quest.vampires.v02_villagers.title: You Salivate...
quest.vampires.v02_villagers.description:
"I was asleep for so long... §cI'm starving."§r

"These §c§ohumans§r will make for a fine meal to feast upon. If I'm lucky, I can even extract their §l§dHeart Crystals§r to §cgrow stronger...§r" 

"Hell knows I could use it. My body has grown particuarly weak during my slumber.

If I §cstrike§r their §cbacks§r, I have an especially good chance of killing them quickly... The less time I leave myself vulnerable, the better.

I should try and pace myself in how many of the docile ones I feast upon... I can obtaining both §l§dHeart Crystals§r §oand§r §l§cweaponry§r from humanity's §oarmed§r forces.

I wonder how strong they've gotten whilst I've slept...?"
quest.vampires.v03_pillagers.title: The Army
quest.vampires.v03_pillagers.description:
"§4These§r are your footmen? §4§oPathetic.§r How fortunate for me... Your own §cweapons§r will become your undoing." 

"Though the gap in our power is obvious, I should still remain cautious..."

"Without breath or a pulse, I can do well in §csneaking up on my prey from behind.§r And if that doesn't work, I can always attack or retreat with a §cdash§r, or knock them away with a §4groundpound§r should I find myself surrounded..."

quest.vampires.beat_tyros.title: End of the Road
quest.vampires.beat_tyros.description:
There's only one thing left to do...

It's time to beat the Abyssal Lord.
quest.vampires.beat_tyros.description_co:
The Abyssal Lord, Tyros, has been vanquished. 

This marks the end of Vampires Strike Back... For now.

More updates are on the way!

In the meantime, why not try beating the pack again with a different class, or on a harder difficulty?

There's a timer at the top of the HUD... How fast can you beat the pack?

Let us know what you thought in the Infernal Studios Discord, and please consider leaving us a review on ModDex.gg!

Thank you so much for playing and beating VSB!!!
quest.vampires.marker_everyone.title: Hand of the King
quest.vampires.marker_everyone.descripti: Ah, the Grand Mansion... The King's Hand must be hiding in here. If I can defeat him, he should surely illuminate where the Guardians are.

With the Hand of the King slain, I can find and defeat any which guardian I please... 

But perhaps it would be worth investigating this Grand Mansion's basement first.

This Key could be useful...
quest.vampires.marker_pickpocketer_mansi: The footsoldiers that populate these lands... I'm sure at least one of them must have valueable information that'll help me find find a way to the Guardians.

Incredible! That Pickpocketer had valueable information... With it, I can find these footmens' base of operations easily. 

It's probably not essential... I could instead spend more time building up my strength and find them through another enemy first. But I'm certain I'll be able to locate the Guardians even sooner by investigating it.
dialogue.vampires.rhelic.rhelic_introduc: I'd like to make a purchase.
dialogue.vampires.rhelic.rhelic_who.text: My name is Rhelic. My story, beyond my name, is of no concern to you.
dialogue.vampires.rhelic.rhelic_where.te: This is my Study. A small pocket dimension where I conduct my work and sell my wares.
dialogue.vampires.rhelic.rhelic_where.ch: Didn't look small on the way in...
Are you a shopkeeper? May I see your wares?
dialogue.vampires.rhelic.not_small.text: This room, specifically, is my Study. The realm beyond this room is the Infinite Library. I'm merely... Housing my study within it for the time being.
dialogue.vampires.rhelic.not_small.choic: ... I won't question that any further.
dialogue.vampires.rhelic.infinite_librar: A world beyond yours that houses many a literature from across the realms. Though, traveling too deep may be a bit much for your... Tender mind to comprehend.
dialogue.vampires.rhelic.rhelic_why.text: I sent for you. The inhabitants of your realm, and realms like it, have a large of amount of life essence. I have been looking for ways to accrue it, so I've sent for folks of strength comparable to yours to help me.
dialogue.vampires.rhelic.rhelic_why.choi: And what do you want of me?
dialogue.vampires.rhelic.rhelic_what.tex: I understand you... Have goals you would like to fulfill. Well, I have procured many items in my travels which may be of use to you. If you provide me Life Essence, and a couple Emeralds, then I will in turn offer you some spare trinkets I have lying around.
dialogue.vampires.rhelic.rhelic_what.cho: Alright, I'll bite. What have you got?
Major Life Essence, that is. You might also know them as 'Permanent Heart Crystals'. If you find yourself short, but would still like to purchase something from me, I also offer Heart Containers, which you can use to extract some of your own Life Essence for easy trading. I do hope it won't... Hurt you too much, should you decide to go through with it...
Alright then. I'd like to make a purchase.
That is the... 'Long and short' of it, yes. Go right ahead.
dialogue.vampires.rhelic.hi.choice.rheli: I'd like to make a purchase.
shop.vampires.rhelic.name: Rhelic
